title: Bounded orbital transfer search
summary: Bounded validated circular/elliptical same-body and interbody transfer intent.

blocks.text: flight.transfers@1.0.0 requires flight.plans@1.0.0. Bounded generator searches same-body apsis opportunities after a 30-second preparation window and validates every accepted candidate through the selected world predictor. Circular and elliptical starts/targets are supported. Efficient minimizes sampled impulse cost; faster minimizes elapsed wait+travel when at least2% earlier. Neither is a global optimum promise. Direct parent/child and sibling/common-parent transfers use bounded zero-revolution Lambert and hyperbolic-ejection seeds, then selected-world differential correction. Up to168 coarse samples, at most24 shortlisted corrections,18 iterations with two finite-difference probes and four damping retries. Each probe uses at most16,384 shared forecast samples; progress chunks contain at most8 samples. Candidates require actual moving SOI handoffs, no contact, a valid editable shared plan and a complete safe destination revolution. Endpoint tolerance max(.001m,lowRadius*1e-9), final apses max(.01m,radius*1e-7); one-year arrival bound. Other relationships and incompatible hosts return diagnostics. Exact-time prediction and progressive flight-plan evaluation are required for interbody searches. The optional relationships metadata declares solver coverage for destination browsing; it is not a feasibility guarantee. Editors group body relationships without guessing that an undeclared provider lacks interbody support. No UI, camera, audio, split-screen or view-prediction provider is required. Cancelling the generator closes child forecasts and its cloned context. TransferProgress.options optionally publishes a new immutable-by-contract array of fully validated best-so-far options; existing providers may omit it. Publication occurs only after shared plan and full destination-revolution validation. Expired departure preparation windows are excluded. Adoption must cancel the outstanding search without arming execution.
